::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 17th 1860  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1860/10[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd),

Many thanks for your scrupulous honesty. The [Websters](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd) are safe come, and I will write about them as soon as I can, but perhaps there may be a little delay - as I am going out for the whole day today, and we have a friend staying with us, so I may not have time to read or write this week.

I am very glad to see them however - and look forward much to enjoying them. There is a cottage flower show coming, at which I am - by way of example to shew all our July wild flowers dried & named, a work that devours all my moments of spare time 

Here is my visitor (the mother of 6 boys) expressing delight in [the Arctic story](other_books/otherbook_276.qmd)

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Miss Ann Smith/ Rectory/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester 17 July (year torn) and London SE 18 July 1860.
